item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] 2 rescued after being trapped in car stuck in retention pond in Spring Hill: HCFR
item.description: Hernando County Fire Rescue (HCFR) said a person accidentally drove into a retention pond in Spring Hill during rainstorms on July 30.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Father who gave gun to Apalachee High School shooter sentenced to serve 15 years in prison
item.description: A man who gave his son the gun he used to kill two students and two teachers at Apalachee High School in Georgia was sentenced Thursday to 15 years in prison.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Democratic Socialists become a rising force in Democratic politics
item.description: CNN polling shows democratic socialists gaining influence inside the Democratic Party as progressive candidates notch primary wins.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Father of boy rescued from pounding California surf says he is beyond grateful to teen lifeguard
item.description: The father of a 10-year-old rescued from pounding surf off the California coast in a dramatic scene captured on video says he is beyond grateful to the teenage lifeguard who saved his son.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Lightning strike caused fire at Divinity Med Spa in Spring Hill: HCFR
item.description: Hernando County Fire Rescue (HCFR) said a lightning strike caused a fire at Divinity Med Spa on Spring Hill Drive.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Rechargeable hand warmers recalled after causing fires, burn injuries and death
item.description: The company has received 1,480 reports of hand warmers overheating, resulting in 15 fires and 350 burn injuries. This includes the death of an 83-year-old in San Diego, California in 2026.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] More than 178,000 heated throws and blankets recalled due to a fire risks
item.description: More than 178,000 heated throws and blankets are being recalled due to a fire hazard. According to the company OCTROT, the electrical cord on the product can detach and ignite.

item.description: Keepers at Prague Zoo used tons of ice on Thursday to give its animals some much-needed relief as yet another heat wave hit Europe.

item.description: Tampa Bay 28 partners with Feeding Bay and Achieva Credit Union for our Pack the Pantries and more initiative. The goal is to bring food and supplies directly to schools where students are at risk of food insecurity.

item.description: President Donald Trump said Thursday he may temporarily withdraw Todd Blanche's nomination for attorney general after two Republican senators have opposed advancing it.

item.description: UEFA member federations agreed Thursday to boycott all FIFA competitions in protest at Gianni Infantino's plan to sell stakes in the World Cup to private equity investors.

item.description: The Federal Reserve has decided to hold interest rates steady in a 9-3 vote. Some economists are predicting a potential rate hike soon.
